feature: Governance page (/governance) Group & Collaboration Sprawl now surfaces the real governance:ownerless-groups check (signal.governance.ownerless-groups) as a registered dashboard metric ('Ownerless Groups'), distinct from the existing 'Ownerless Teams' row -- previously never registered in lib/dashboard-registry/src/metrics.ts, so only the raw ownerlessGroupCount property name was ever visible anywhere it surfaced.
notes: WIRING: new metric governance.ownerlessGroupCount (sourceType monitor_profile, sourceKey governance:ownerless-groups) registered in lib/dashboard-registry/src/metrics.ts. governance.tsx's METRIC_KEYS now includes it so useTopicHealthLive resolves it via POST /api/dashboard/resolve. GroupSprawl.tsx's SPRAWL_ROWS gained an 'Ownerless Groups' row right after 'Ownerless Teams'.
data-testid='sprawl-row-governance.ownerlessGroupCount' added to the new <li> (small, scoped addition alongside sibling rows, which also now carry sprawl-row-<metricKey> testids from this same edit).

D2 asserts the row renders SOME value (a real count or the honest em-dash) rather than requiring this shared dev tenant to have live ownerless-group data -- coverage state is a pre-existing property of the tenant's scan history, not something this change controls.

REAL CONTRACT (dashboard-data.ts): POST /api/dashboard/resolve takes body { metrics: string[] }, not metricKeys, and responds { results: Record<metricKey, MetricResult> }, not { metrics: ... }. D1 uses containsAny/containsNone against the raw response body, matching group-sprawl.json's (#1117) documented BuildConsole HttpTestExecutor jsonPath limitation -- its tokenizer only supports dot-propName/bracket-index segments and cannot address a results object keyed by a literal-dot metric key like governance.ownerlessGroupCount.

KNOWN TEST-ACCOUNT LIMITATION (found live 2026-08-17, not caused by this change): TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL/PASSWORD is an Assessment-tier account (mspRole=Assessment). requireAuth.ts's ROLE_ORDER puts Assessment/Free below CustomerUser deliberately -- 'every requireRole() floor in the codebase is CustomerUser or higher' -- so this shared testbed account 403s on ANY CustomerUser-gated route, including dashboard-data.ts's /api/dashboard/resolve. Live run against this account: D1 (API) 403'd with 'Insufficient privileges -- CustomerUser or above required', and D2 (UI) found the sprawl row absent because the whole /governance page's useTopicHealthLive fetch 403s the same way for this account -- GroupSprawl shows its honest 'AWAITING DATA' empty state with zero rows, not specifically missing the new one. This is a pre-existing, correct-by-design gap (Assessment is the pre-purchase money-path role; the customer-facing Governance dashboard is intentionally CustomerUser+), not a defect in this change, and equally blocks #1117's not-yet-verified group-sprawl.json manifest, which hits the same endpoint with the same account. D1/D2 are left in place as the correct assertions for a CustomerUser-tier account -- this environment currently has none available to this session.
